title: Follow camera basics
summary: The camera orbits a point 1.5 m above Wolf at 4.5 m distance with a 43 degree vertical field of view. Modes change these through param rows.
values: LockCamParam row 0: camDistTarget 4.5, camFovY 43, chrOrg_offset_Y 1.5, lockRotXShiftRatio 0.45. CameraParam row 0: chrOrgOffset (0, 1.5, 0). Crouch camera row 100: offset Y 1.0, distance 3.5.
how: LockCamParam (id from CameraSetParam slot) + CameraParam; exe ChrExFollowCam (vtable 0x1429a7d88).
check: Walk in the open: camera distance 4.5 m and FOV 43.
note: His sim reads only row 0; slot rows are not switched.

title: Camera slots swap the param rows
summary: Animations choose camera behaviour by a slot number (TAE 155). CameraSetParam row 0 maps each slot to a LockCamParam and CameraParam row with blend times in and out.
how: TAE 155 SetLockParamID -> FUN_140737430 (slot 1..45, reset to 1 every frame); blend over beginTime, back over endTime.
check: Hang from a ledge and during a deathblow: the camera changes as the slot rows say.
note: Slot 7 (ground wire shoot) has no row, so defaults apply.

title: Pitch limits free and locked
summary: Looking up and down is limited. Free camera allows -40 to 80 degrees; locked on it is limited to +-30 degrees and widens when the target is far above or below.
values: CameraParam row 0: rotRangeXMin -40, rotRangeXMax 80 (1.396 rad), rotRangeXAtLockMin/Max -30/+30, rotRangeLerpBeginHeight 0.5 m and EndHeight 3.0 m blend toward the free range by height gap. LockCamParam rotRangeMinX overrides the lower limit: -40 default, -60 hang (500), -20 swim (2000), -80 dive (3000), 0 dive transitions (4300/4400).
check: Lock on a taller boss and look down: pitch clamps at the +-30 degrees until the height gap exceeds 0.5 m.

title: Camera turn speed from the stick
summary: Stick (and mouse) camera rotation speed grows with how far the stick is pushed, and a high-speed boost ramps in over 0.6 s of holding.
values: CameraParam row 0 (rad/s): rotSpeed_Min/Max X 0.977/2.932, Y 0.977/3.665; rotHiSpeed_Min/Max X 2.199/6.109, Y 2.688/7.575; rotHiSpeedRateIncTime 0.6 s. Speed is lerp(min, max, s squared) with s the stick magnitude.
check: Push the right stick slowly and fully: full push turns about 210 deg/s horizontally after the boost.
note: Units assumed radians per second; the exe formula for the s curve is taken from ours.

title: Auto re-centering after camera input
summary: After you move the camera by hand it stays put for 2 s, then the camera drifts back behind Wolf over 1 s.
values: CameraParam row 0: rotCtrlEndWaitTime 2.0, rotCtrlEndReleaseTime 1.0; transChaseByControlEndWaitTime / ReleaseTime (position chase, same pattern). Camera object +0x150 = 1 on input, counts down +0x154.
check: Swing the camera sideways, release, run forward: camera holds 2 s then re-aligns.

title: Focus chase rates
summary: The camera focus lags behind Wolf: horizontal 20 percent and vertical 30 percent of the gap per 1/30 s.
values: CameraParam row 0: chrTransChaseRateXZ_ForNormal 0.2, chrTransChaseRateY_ForNormal 0.3, targetChaseRateXZForNormal 0.1. Row 5000 sets 1.0 (snap). Focus moves in 1/30 s sub-steps: blend = 1 - (1 - rate)^(dt*30).
check: Run in a straight line then stop: focus catches up in about 0.3 s.

title: Camera position chase and distance rates
summary: The camera position follows its ideal spot with its own rates and a distance rate that speeds up after hitting a wall.
values: CameraParam row 0: targetChaseRateAtLockXZ 0.4, AtLockY 0.3 (unlocked XZ 0.1 working rate, Y targetChaseRateY 0.4), angle ramp targetChaseRateAngMin/Max 10 and 20 deg, targetChaseDistRateXZ/Y 0.4, ForHitWall 1.0 for 2 s after a wall hit (targetChaseDistRateTime). Pitch outside limits forces rate 1.
check: Spin the camera quickly around Wolf: position catches up with a lag, no lag when pitch hits a limit.
note: FUN_140831190/1408311b0 overrides not traced.

title: Fulcrum swing when running sideways
summary: The camera hangs off a fulcrum that trails Wolf, so running sideways makes the view swing round to trail the run.
values: CameraParam row 0: targetTransChaseRateXZ/Y 0.4, fulcrumDistRate 0.5, fulcrumDistMin 2 m, fulcrumDistRateByLrMove Min/Max 0.1/0.99 over 0.3 m/s lateral. Measured effect: 31 deg after 0.5 s, 53 at 1 s, 75 at 2 s at 6 m/s across.
check: Run perpendicular to the view: camera swings about 30 degrees in half a second.
note: sekiro-rs has no fulcrum.

title: Unlocked pitch follows climbs and falls
summary: While not locked on, the camera tilts to follow up/down motion unless Wolf is running toward the camera.
values: CameraParam isEnableChrChaseRotX 1, chrChaseRotXInvalidAngle 80 deg (row 0; 0 in rows 200-500). Applies when the move stick is zero or its dot with the view is below cos(angle).
how: FUN_140733e50 pitch from focus - fulcrum; ChrManipulator +0xc0 stick vector.
check: Walk up a slope and drop: camera tilts with the terrain only when the stick is not toward the camera.
note: The meaning of the -z row as toward the camera is inferred.

title: Lock-on range by light level
summary: You can only lock enemies within 30 m in light, 15 m in the dark and 10 m in pitch darkness.
values: LockCamParam chrLockRangeMaxRadius 30, _forD 15, _forPD 10; map visibility type (MAP_VISIBILITY_TYPE_GOOD 0 / DARK 1 / PICHDARK 2, env 3040). Row 0 values; defaults in the def are 15/-1/-1.
check: Lock on an enemy at 25 m in the open; then in a pitch-dark cave only inside 10 m.
note: Dark variants not implemented in either project.

title: Which enemy a new lock picks
summary: A lock press takes the nearest enemy in front of Wolf or the camera. The accepted zones are a close cone around Wolf and two camera cones.
values: ChrFrontRange: within 5 m and 30 deg of Wolf facing; CamFrontNear: 60 deg sideways, 30 deg up/down within 8 m of the camera; CamFrontFar: 45 deg, 30 deg out to 200 m limit (clamped to lock range 30 m). Defaults at LockTgtManImp +0x2944..+0x2984.
check: Stand with an enemy at your back and press lock: nothing locks; turn so it is within 45 deg of the camera and it does.
note: Extra distance terms fVar71 / local_2a8 not traced.

title: Switching target with the right stick
summary: While locked, flicking the right stick moves the lock to the best enemy in that screen direction. Two thresholds stop jitter.
values: Stick |axis| < 0.5 re-arms, > 0.95 fires. Cooldowns +0x2844/+0x2848 set to 0.5 s after a switch. Candidate zone while locked: CamFront Near/Far half angles yaw 60/45 deg, pitch 30/30, radius 8/200. Score = cos(angle(d, input)) / |d| in screen space, best above cos(pi/2).
check: Lock one of two enemies and flick the stick toward the other: it switches once, and not again for 0.5 s.
note: Stick y sign not verified: exe reads it unnegated.

title: Switching target with the mouse
summary: Mouse movement switches the lock when it moves fast enough. Thresholds are in raw counts per frame.
values: Mouse delta negated; re-arm below 25 counts, fire above 50 counts per poll; the same 0.5 s cooldown. Raw counts from DirectInput DIMOUSESTATE, relative axes, no scaling.
check: Lock on two enemies and flick the mouse sideways quickly.
note: The mouse binding table (action 0x54/0x55) and sign are open.

title: Lock point on the target
summary: The camera and attacks aim at a fixed body point on the locked enemy, DummyPoly 220 (chest).
values: Target position P = focus + lockTgtPosRate 0.7 * (dummy 220 - focus); lock mark drawn at dummy 220.
how: CameraParam.lockTgtPosRate; dummy 220 on every character model.
check: Lock a boss and check the reticle sits on its chest.

title: Lock-on pitch framing
summary: Locked on, the camera pitches so the target sits half a screen above centre, giving a 20-30 degree look down in melee and steep views over the target on head kicks.
values: half = FOV * lockRotXShiftRatio (0.45) * 0.5; a = asin(dist * sin(half) / |P - focus|); target pitch = a + half - elevation(P - focus); chased at lockRotChaseRateX 0.6 per 1/30 s (CameraParam 4000 deathblow: 0.4). Row 7000 shift 0.23.
check: Fight a boss in melee range: the view looks down 20-30 degrees.

title: Lock-on turning rate
summary: The locked camera swings toward the target with a yaw rate of 30 percent of the gap per 1/30 s and a pitch rate of 60 percent.
values: CameraParam lockRotChaseRateY 0.3, lockRotChaseRateX 0.6 (4000: 0.2 / 0.4), lockRotChasePlayAng X/Y 0 (dead zone).
check: Lock a target and circle: camera turns smoothly, no snapping.

title: Lock on a dead or out-of-range target
summary: When the locked enemy dies or leaves range the lock is dropped. Whether it jumps to another enemy was not settled.
values: Lockable = alive and within chrLockRangeMaxRadius. Ours drops the lock; Sekiro also has an auto-retarget feature (wiki "Auto Target").
check: Kill one of two close enemies while locked and see if the lock moves to the other.
note: Wiki search snippets mention auto target after a kill; not verified in the exe here.

title: Soft lock when not locked on
summary: Even without a lock, attacks and shinobi tools pick a nearby enemy to aim at, within a small cone and range.
values: LockCamParam close attack: radius 3 m (dark 3, pitch-dark 3), +-30 deg, height -3..+1 m; bullets (tools): 30 m (dark 15, pitch-dark 10), +-15 deg. HKS act 156 SetAutoCaptureTarget runs the first 1/6 s of attacks when not locked (upper_limit 0.1667 s).
check: Attack with no lock next to an enemy at 2 m off-axis: Wolf turns to it; at 4 m he does not.
note: Bullet range not used in ours.

title: Boss and move cameras: distance events
summary: Special attacks and boss anims push the camera in or out by TAE 153, easing between the current and target distance.
values: TAE 153 CameraModule3: distance target from LockCamParam camDistTarget chased at CameraParam lockCamParamLerpRate 0.05, or StartInterpolationSpeed/EndInterpolationSpeed (persists); SlowStart eases by 1 - (p - 1)^2; used distance follows at 0.1 per frame.
how: TAE dispatcher FUN_140b59170 case 0x99 -> FUN_140b51680 -> camera singleton DAT_143d5c0d0 +0x70..+0x85.
check: Perform a combat art with a camera pull and watch the distance lerp.

title: Camera look limits (TAE 151)
summary: An animation can restrict how far the camera may turn around a body direction, for cinematic holds.
values: Limits = centre (view along DummyPoly matrix -row 2) + four event angles; chased at lockCamParamLerpRate per call. Without event, pitch limits chase rotRangeMinX/MaxX and yaw rotRangeYMin/Max (full circle in most rows; +-90 deg in the six cover-style rows 200-500 centred on Wolf matrix row 2 + rotBaseY).
check: Hug a wall: the camera is limited to +-90 deg around the wall normal.
note: Cone centre from the dummy basis is partly guessed.

title: Forced camera angle (TAE 156)
summary: Some animations rotate the camera to a set pitch and yaw relative to Wolf, mostly deathblows and cutscene-style moves.
values: TAE 156 SetCameraAngle: VerticalAngle, HorizontalAngle, InterpolationType, OverrideVertical/Horizontal. 211 events on Wolf anims (184 with vertical, 116 with horizontal override). Eases by w = 1 - (p - 1)^2; yaw = Horizontal + Wolf yaw. Lock turning is skipped meanwhile.
check: Perform a deathblow: camera moves to the authored angle.
note: Gyoubu final blow a225_510090 angles not traced.

title: Camera wall collision cast
summary: A sphere cast from the focus backward stops the camera at walls. There is no minimum distance, so a wall behind Wolf can put the camera at his head.
values: CameraParam camCastSphereRadius 0.05; distance = max(hit, 1e-5) of the arm. After a hit the distance chase uses the ForHitWall rate 1.0 for 2 s. escapeWall* fields (wing length 0.01, rotation 0) are effectively off in row 0.
check: Back Wolf against a wall and look: camera sits just in front of the wall.
note: His camera keeps a ray push-in with its own clamp.

title: Camera safe margin
summary: After placing the camera it is pulled slightly toward Wolf so it does not clip into geometry.
values: camSafeMarginRate 0.1 of the distance, capped by camSafeMarginMax 0.3 m (distance minus 1e-5). Applies when Game.IsUseSPChrExFollowCam (default 1).
check: Look at a wall from 1 m: camera stays 0.1 m off it.

title: Wolf fades when the camera is close
summary: When the camera comes within 0.5 m of Wolf, he fades out so you can see through him.
values: playerFadeDist 0.5 m; alpha falls 2.5 per second to a floor of 0, climbs back at 5 per second (Game.Camera.Obstacle.* defaults). Slot manager FUN_140b21ca0 / FUN_140b22000; PlayerIns vtable +0x400 stores alpha +0x2074.
check: Back into a wall with the camera arm shortened: Wolf dissolves.
note: Draw path may be a dither-fade material parameter, not plain alpha.

title: Fading objects between camera and target
summary: Objects that block the view of Wolf can fade out. The cast uses a 0.3 m sphere and a filter group for fading occluders.
values: camCastSphereRadiusForFade 0.3; Havok filter group 0x76 (118, "Camera (fade occluding OBJ)") paired with objects 0x18/0x19/0x1b/0x20, 0x29, 0x2f, 0x43, 0x6c, 0x77 and enemy groups 2, 5, 7, 10, 0x66, 0x67, 0x69, 0x6a; fade to AlphaMin 0.2. Enemy fade depends on a byte at *(owner+0x18)+0x1f == 2 (unidentified).
how: Camera +0x3ad parked in ours; FUN_14094ea80, FUN_140933390, FUN_140b21d40.
check: Stand behind a hanging blind or wooden screen with the camera behind it: it dithers away.
note: Whether ordinary enemies fade is open (needs a live read).

title: Camera shake from animations
summary: Hits, landings and big attacks shake the camera using small recorded camera animations triggered by TAE events.
values: TAE RumbleCam events 145/146 global on the player anims, 144/147 local with FalloffStart/End metres on enemies; other/default.rumblebnd camera_NNN.hkx = 42 shakes, e.g. 61: 0.17 s / 1.1 deg, 56: 0.3 s / 4 deg, 377: 3.3 s rumble. Applied as rotation delta from frame 0 on top of the follow camera.
check: Take a heavy hit or land from a height and watch for a 1-4 degree shake lasting 0.2-0.3 s.

title: Camera rows for the grapple move
summary: The grapple move start uses camera rows that enable a default camera angle and a wire rotation, contrary to the earlier notes.
values: CameraParam 1700 and 1800 (slots 18/19): isEnableDefaultCamera 1, defaultRot 45 deg (0.785), defaultAngX 15 deg (0.262), wireRotX/Y 0.785, fallHeightMargine 10; 1700 targetChaseDist rates 0.8. Boss variants 5200017/18, 10001700/1800, 15200017/18 repeat it. Earlier kb says wireRotX/Y are 0 in every row, which is wrong for these rows.
how: CameraSetParam slots 18 and 19 from TAE 155 on a000_202010-12; exe consumer of wireRot* not traced.
check: Grapple to a high point: camera should swing toward a 45 degree heading with 15 degrees of tilt.
note: Disagrees with docs/kb/grapple.md ("wireRotX/Y are 0 in every row"); the data wins.

title: Default camera for dives and wires
summary: Some rows turn on a default camera: a fixed heading and tilt the camera drifts to, used in the dive transitions and the grapple move.
values: isEnableDefaultCamera 1 rows: 1700, 1800 (45 deg heading, 15 deg tilt), 4300 and 4400 (30 deg heading, 0 tilt, pitch range 0..0, targetChaseRateY 1.0; slots 44 and 45 for SwimToDive and DiveToAir).
how: CameraParam defaultRot / defaultAngX; not decoded in the exe here.
check: Dive from the surface and watch the camera fix its pitch.
note: Consumer in ChrCam not located.

title: Fall camera
summary: While falling a long way the camera has settings for looking down, with a base height and times.
values: CameraParam row 0: isEnableFall 1, fallBaseHeight 5 m, fallHeightMargine 2 m (10 in air wire rows), fallMinTime 0.2 s, fallMaxTime 0.3 s, fallTargetRot 0. directPitchAng 60 deg, directPitchRate 0.06.
how: CameraParam only; ChrCam consumer not traced.
check: Jump from 12 m and watch the camera look-down amount.
note: Purpose inferred from field names.

title: Force front lock time
summary: A CameraParam field forceFrontLockTime (0.4 s in row 0) suggests the camera is forced to face the target for a short time after locking.
values: forceFrontLockTime 0.4 s; no consumer found.
check: Press lock with the camera facing away and time how long it takes to face the target.
note: Meaning is a guess from the name.

title: Cover look camera
summary: Peeking around a corner shifts the camera sideways and brings it close.
values: Slots 4/5: LockCamParam 300 camDistTarget 1.5; CameraParam 300/400 chrOrgOffsetX +1.0 / -1.0, offset Y 1.25, yaw range +-90 deg, resetBaseY 180 deg, targetTransChaseRateY 0.8. Cover idle slot 3: CameraParam 200 offset Y 1.25, yaw +-90 deg, distance 3.5.
how: TAE 155 values 4/5 on a000_205010/205011/205020/205021; CameraSetParam row 0.
check: Peek around a corner: camera moves 1 m to that side at distance 1.5 m.
note: Ours leans the focus 1.2 m out and 0.3 m forward; the data says 1.0 m offset and 1.5 m distance.

title: Swim and dive cameras
summary: Swimming raises the focus to 2.0 m and the dive allows looking steeply down.
values: Swim slot 21: CameraParam 2000 chrOrgOffsetY 2.0, chase XZ 0.5, at-lock 0.8/0.6; LockCamParam 2000 rotRangeMinX -20. Dive slot 31: CameraParam 3000 rotRangeXMin -80 deg, XZ 0.5; LockCamParam 3000 -80. Swim kick uses 2100 (XZ 0.1). Dive upward/downward slots 33/35: LockCam 3200/3400 pitch min 0.
check: Dive and look straight down: pitch limit reaches -80 deg.

title: Death camera
summary: On death the camera pulls out to 7.5 m and holds for 2 s.
values: Slot 8: LockCamParam/CameraParam 700 (camDistTarget 7.5, chrOrgOffsetY 1.0), beginTime 2.0 s, endTime 0.25 s.
check: Die and watch the camera pull back.

title: Deathblow camera slot
summary: Deathblow animations use slot 41 with a slower lock chase so the camera stays steady on the kill.
values: Slot 41: CameraParam 4000 lockRotChaseRateX 0.4, Y 0.2, targetChaseRateAtLockXZ 0.2, Y 0.15; begin 0.0 s, end 1.0 s. 255 anims (a200_5xxxxx) set it.
check: Execute a deathblow: camera lag increases for the duration.
